reviewer_text:
AppleMusic: PASS for this checkpoint

Visible result

Card/grid structure is stable.

The red-star / ?????? card now appears as a complete card slot rather than an incomplete icon-only card.

First-row media cards remain intact.

Second-row cards remain aligned inside the same row group.

Bottom partial cards remain partial/review-style and were not incorrectly promoted into full cards.

No visible pollution from the QQ member-list rule or Python.org content-column behavior.

Visible issues

Topbar labels/control boxes are still visually dense.

Left review/background strip remains visible.

This remains display/review evidence only.

Protected-set regression: none visible.

QQ: CONDITIONAL PASS

Visible result

Right-side member area is more complete than earlier versions.

The member list region appears to include the main consecutive member rows after the ????? 1263? header.

Announcement rows are still visually separate as notice_item / boundary-review content, not obviously swallowed into the member list.

Message/thread/sidebar geometry does not appear polluted by the AppleMusic card-slot rule.

Visible issues

4.2 boundary_review_region still looks like a noisy transition between announcement and member list.

The member list still may not include every visible compact row farther down the right sidebar; lower rows appear less clearly boxed.

Right sidebar remains visually cluttered.

Topbar and message-thread overlays remain dense.

Protected-set regression: no obvious regression, but right sidebar is not clean enough for full pass.

Python.org: CONDITIONAL PASS

Visible result

I do not see new large wrong media-card slots caused by the dense-row placeholder rule.

Numbering still appears concentrated in the central content area, not across the whole wide primary background.

Bottom duplicate partial-card overlays appear reduced compared with earlier overlaid versions.

Browser chrome / header / content-column separation remains broadly consistent.

Visible issues

Hero/code/text area is still heavily fragmented.

Many orange text/link boxes overlap in the hero panel.

Cards and news/events rows remain dense.

Blue review/structure boxes still overlap heavily in the main content area.

Bottom page sections are still visually busy; this is not a clean page-detail rendering yet.

Protected-set regression: no obvious regression from the new media-card slot rule.

Overall
AppleMusic: PASS for this checkpoint
QQ: CONDITIONAL PASS
Python.org: CONDITIONAL PASS
